project_name: NoteGPT_TRANSCRIPT_Discarded By Clan! I Dominate All Beast Contracts With System!💕#anime
char_desc: young Korean man, 22 years old, sharp jawline, dark swept-back hair, intense dark eyes, lean muscular build
art_style: manhwa webtoon korean comic style, clean precise linework, vibrant saturated colors, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital illustration

beats.beat: Gi Chun's adoptive father reveals he adopted him and is sacrificing him to transfer his S-rank talent to Gi Hao.
Gi Hao celebrates gaining S-rank Beastmaster talent from Gi Chun.
Gi Hao orders Gi Chun to be dragged out and dealt with.
Gi Chun, injured, awakens the all-knowing eye system, which heals him and enhances his abilities.
Xiao Ying, the system's AI, explains the all-knowing eye's functions and achievement rewards.
beats.setting: Gi Chun's mind/immediate surroundings, immediately after

beats.beat: Gi Chun is attacked by two enemies and uses the system to predict their moves.
Gi Chun defeats his first enemy and earns a galaxy bat reward.
Gi Chun receives materials for his pet's first evolution as an achievement reward.
beats.setting: Gi Chun's mind/immediate surroundings, immediately after combat

beats.beat: Gi Chun rushes back to school for the pet contract ceremony.
Gi Hao successfully contracts an A-rank pet, the Flame Griffin, solidifying his new S-rank talent.
Gi Hao publicly mocks Gi Chun for being an F-rank loser after the talent swap.
Students discuss the new energy field that allows talent swapping, though the swapped talent weakens.
Classmates defend Gi Chun, highlighting his past kindness and demanding his talent back.
Gi Hao's father dismisses the students, stating Gi Chun is family property and must pay them back.
Gi Hao orders his Flame Griffin to attack the students defending Gi Chun.
Gi Chun steps in to protect his classmates, using a stick against the Flame Griffin.
Gi Chun uses his all-knowing eye to identify the Flame Griffin's weak spot.
Students are amazed Gi Chun can spot weaknesses even without S-rank talent.
Gi Hao's A-rank beast is hurt by F-rank Gi Chun, making Gi Hao furious.
Xiao Yingu, Gi Chun's former fiancée, uses her Dark Moon Shadow Dream pet to stop the fight, helping Gi Hao.
Students realize Xiao Yingu's engagement has shifted from Gi Chun to Gi Hao due to the talent swap.
Gi Chun points out Gi Hao broke school rules by ordering his pet to attack a classmate.
Gi Chun declares he will contract a pet immediately and challenge Gi Hao, with severe stakes.
Classmates express concern, believing an F-rank talent can only contract F-rank pets, making victory impossible.
Gi Chun reassures his friends he won't lose.
Gi Chun asks Jonah to help him find F-rank pets with strong evolution lines.
Gi Chun's Eye of Mystery detects a hidden evolution route for the F-rank pet Little Water Cannon into an S-rank Water Sprite.
Gi Chun contracts the Little Water Cannon, unlocking an achievement and receiving evolution materials.
Gi Hao and others mock Gi Chun for contracting the weakest F-rank pet, Little Water Blaster.
Gi Chun commands Little Water Blaster to evolve, causing a powerful energy surge.
Spectators are confused, as no one in the Federation has ever evolved a Water Sprout (Little Water Blaster's base form).
Gi Hao dismisses the evolution, believing an F-rank pet can only reach D or C rank at best.
The evolved form looks similar to before, leading observers to believe the evolution failed.
Gi Hao, confident the evolution failed, orders his Blazing Griffin to attack Gi Chun's pet with a killer move.
Classmates urge Gi Chun to recall his pet to avoid backlash from its death.
Bubble (Little Water Blaster) is hit and appears to be defeated, leading Gi Hao to declare victory.
Gi Chun remains unaffected, hinting at a hidden evolution path.
Little Water Bubble's hidden evolution path is revealed, and it rebuilds into the S-class humanoid pet, Narcissus.
Narcissus is revealed to be a top-tier S-class pet with incredible water control powers.
Gi Hao cannot believe an F-class pet beast evolved straight to S-class.
Narcissus dodges Gi Hao's Flame Griffin, seemingly toying with it.
Xiao Yingu joins Gi Hao, attacking Gi Chun with her Dark Moon Shadow Cat.
Gi Chun calls out Gi Hao and Xiao Yingu for ganging up with two A-ranked pets.
Gi Chun defeats both Gi Hao and Xiao Yingu, winning the challenge.
Gi Hao refuses to apologize, claiming Gi Chun only won due to luck and his S-level pet.
Gi Chun earns a Super experience pill for his first pet evolution, boosting his level by one.
beats.setting: Gi Chun's mind/immediate surroundings, after challenge

beats.beat: Gi Chun realizes the pill fixes his F-level growth problem by allowing him to level up with pet evolutions.
beats.setting: Gi Chun's mind/immediate surroundings, after challenge

beats.beat: Gi Chun tricks Gi Hao into believing a pill is poison, forcing him to kneel and apologize.
Gi Chun's father, the G family head and a fifth-level beast tamer, arrives and threatens Gi Chun.
Gi Chun defiantly confronts the G family head.
The G family head offers Gi Chun his life if he kneels and swears loyalty, acknowledging his S-rank pet.
Gi Chun refuses the G family head's offer.
The G family head uses Golden Feather Strike to attack Gi Chun.
Shihan, a beast girl, appears and stops the G family head's attack.
Shihan is revealed to be a Tingu, a human-like beastkin.
Gi Chun unlocks an achievement for bonding with a beastkin and receives a Berserk pill.
beats.setting: Gi Chun's mind/immediate surroundings, during confrontation

beats.beat: The G family head uses Sky Gold Rotor Storm Cage to trap Gi Chun and Shihan.
Narcissus attacks the G family head, a tier six beast tamer, with a tornado.
Gi Chun, a second-rank beast tamer, defeats the fifth-rank G family head in three seconds.
Shihan carries the drained Gi Chun away from the scene.
Gi Hao kicks his unconscious father, blaming him for picking an idiot like Gi Chun.
The G family head orders a city-wide search for Gi Chun, with instructions to kill on sight.
Shihan reveals she is Gi Chun's sister from a different father and mother.
Shihan's identity is exposed, and the elders of the Sky Dog Clan are coming for her.
Gi Chun decides to take the Beast Master Association's Hunter Tower trial to get stronger quickly.
Shihan leaves Gi Chun, hoping he will be strong enough next time they meet.
The Hunter Tower is introduced as a dangerous trial site for top beast masters with five independent floors.
Students from Fenction Royal Beast University are observing the Hunter Tower trials.
Gi Chun announces his intention to challenge the Hunter Tower trial.
Hunter Tower officials and students doubt Gi Chun, a high schooler with F-level talent, can pass.
Gi Chun expresses confidence, stating he's not there to die and will be the first high schooler to pass.
The G family arrives, learning Gi Chun entered the Hunter Tower, believing he's seeking death.
Gi Chun enters the first floor, a dark cave environment with insectoid beasts.
Xiao Yan (the system) provides a map hack, detecting lurking insect beasts.
Gi Chun rushes through the level, surprising observers who expected him to deal with ambushes.
Gi Chun faces the final boss, a Black Gold Centipede with a tough shell.
beats.setting: Hunter Tower, first floor, boss arena

beats.beat: Gi Chun uses Narcissus to exploit the centipede's internal weak spot, destroying it from the inside.
beats.setting: Hunter Tower, first floor, boss arena

beats.beat: Gi Chun clears the first floor, setting a new fastest record for Hunter Tower.
Gi Chun chooses a psychic skill manual as an extra divine reward for breaking the record.
Gi Chun decides to continue to the second floor, despite observers calling it reckless.
beats.setting: Hunter Tower, exit/entrance to next floor
